purpose: Frozen player-side query wording for independent smart-search evaluation. This file intentionally contains no expected fixture IDs and must not be edited to improve benchmark scores.
provenance: Derived from separate Sims mod-management player-problem research and product evidence before target mapping.

Find a specifically named gameplay utility.
Find a specifically named UI cheat mod.
Find a specifically named shared dependency.
Find the object-placement utility commonly called TOOL.
Find a specifically named gameplay mod if the corpus contains it.

Find files associated with Lumpinou.
Find files associated with Lot 51.

Find MCCC despite an incomplete misspelled name.
